title: Adult Pottery 6-Week Course
source_quote:
Adult Pottery 6-Week Course
Tuesdays, November 3, 10, 17, 24; December 1, 8 ~ 5:30pm to 7:30pm
evidence_sentence: The six-week pottery course page says participants learn glazing and that all supplies and firings are included.
evidence_quote: With access to three distinct kilns—wood, raku, and electric—participants can experience a range of firing methods that bring their work to life.
summary: A six-week Tuesday pottery course for adults 18+ covering hand-building, wheel work, and glazing. Includes firings in the studio's wood, raku, and electric kilns. All supplies and firings included.
